facts.text: The resort is on an island in the remote Huvadhu Atoll in the Maldives.
facts.excerpt: Located within the remote Huvadhu Atoll, the island is a retreat for ocean enthusiasts and mindful travelers

facts.text: A 360-degree house reef surrounds the island.
facts.excerpt: 360° house reef is a vibrant underwater sanctuary surrounding the island.

facts.text: Coral gardens on the house reef have colorful fish, rays and reef sharks, just steps from shore.
facts.excerpt: Just steps from shore, guests can explore coral gardens filled with colorful fish, rays, and reef sharks. Accessible from every beach and villa

facts.text: Villas are split between the beach and above the lagoon, plus the three-bedroom Kiaali Residence at the edge of the house reef.
facts.excerpt: 36 nestled on the beach, 14 set above the lagoon, and the expansive three-bedroom Kiaali Residence positioned at the edge of the house reef

facts.text: Every villa has floor-to-ceiling windows and a private deck, and some have plunge pools.
facts.excerpt: Each villa offers floor-to-ceiling windows and private decks, with select options including plunge pools.

facts.text: The Kiaali Residence has a private infinity pool and 24-hour butler service, with direct ocean access.
facts.excerpt: This expansive retreat features a private infinity pool, 24-hour butler service and seamless indoor-outdoor living

facts.text: Overwater Sunset Villas have a sun deck with daybed and direct access to the house reef.
facts.excerpt: features a king bed, indoor bathtub, sun deck with daybed and direct access to the house reef

facts.text: Instead of a traditional indoor kids' club, the resort offers outdoor learning and adventure-based activities for children.
facts.excerpt: Instead of a traditional indoor kids’ club, we provide outdoor learning and adventure-based activities

facts.text: Children can join hands-on sessions in the marine lab with a resident marine biologist.
facts.excerpt: hands-on sessions in our marine lab with a resident marine biologist

facts.text: Ocean Lab experiences include plankton observation, shark ecology and Snorkel with Purpose sessions.
facts.excerpt: and Plankton Observation to Shark Ecology and, Snorkel with Purpose

facts.text: The Vidhun Spa has five private villas offering Ayurveda therapies and Dhivehi beys-inspired massages.
facts.excerpt: At The Vidhun Spa, experience the essence of Maldivian holistic healing in five private villas. Enjoy authentic Ayurveda therapies and Dhivehi beys-inspired massages

facts.text: KOI is an overwater Japanese restaurant with an open kitchen where guests can interact with the chef.
facts.excerpt: KOI is an intimate overwater Japanese restaurant overlooking the beautiful horizon of the Indian Ocean. With an open kitchen where you can interact with the chef

facts.text: The Island Grill has a wood-fired oven and tables and swing chairs set on white sand.
facts.excerpt: A traditional grill combined with a wood fired oven complements the open kitchen décor where guests can watch chefs at work. Tables and swing chairs are set on a blanket of fine white sand.

facts.text: Treehouse Dining is set 5 meters above the shoreline, with views of the Indian Ocean and the sunset.
facts.excerpt: Set 5 meters above the shoreline, Treehouse Dining offers a distinctive destination dining experience with sweeping views of the Indian Ocean and the sunset over Hadahaa.

facts.text: From October 2026 to April 2027, six MICHELIN-starred chefs appear in the Masters of Food & Wine series.
facts.excerpt: From October 2026 to April 2027, Park Hyatt Maldives Hadahaa presents **Masters of Food & Wine**, an exceptional culinary journey shaped by **six acclaimed MICHELIN-starred chefs**.

facts.text: During the festive season, a mandatory dining experience applies to all in-house guests.
facts.excerpt: During the festive season, a mandatory dining experience applies to all in-house guests

facts.text: Getting there from Velana International Airport in Male involves a domestic flight followed by a speedboat transfer.
facts.excerpt: your journey to Park Hyatt Maldives Hadahaa continues with a seamless domestic flight followed by a scenic speedboat transfer

facts.text: Certain room amenities are discontinued or only available on request for sustainability, so guests are invited to check what to bring.
facts.excerpt: certain room amenities are discontinued or only available upon request. We invite you to learn what essentials you may need to bring

facts.text: Villas have high, angled timber roofs that keep them cool, and water is purified at the hotel in recycled-glass bottles.
facts.excerpt: with high, angled timber roofs that keep accommodations cool and with recycled-glass bottles of water purified at the hotel

facts.text: The Island Grill serves regionally inspired dishes with flavors and spices native to the southern atolls.
facts.excerpt: The Island Grill, serves up an array of regionally inspired dishes with flavors and spices native to the southern atolls

facts.text: Hadahaa is one of the Maldives' most unspoiled settings.
facts.excerpt: a sanctuary where nature and luxury blend seamlessly in one of the Maldives’ most unspoiled settings

facts.text: The resort won World of Hyatt Hotel of the Year.
facts.excerpt: World of Hyatt Annual Award - Hotel of the Year
